<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex002032026-10-1403-19-48" status="unreviewed"> <milestone unit="section" n="III.12 rang gi bstan bcos kyi 'brel ba (36b3–37b6)"/> 	<milestone n="a. 'bum pa'" unit="section"/>gnyis pa rang gi bstan bcos kyi 'brel ba ni | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5611">'buM pa</rs> ltar na khyod kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur pa'i 'grel pa rtsom na de kun kyi rgyan yin par khyod nyid kyi ji ltar rtogs ce na zhes pa'i rtsod pa zhig gdon no || 
	<milestone n="b. mahA" unit="section"/>
	<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">ma hA</rs> ltar na khyod bshad par dam bca' byas nas bstan bcos 'chad na | bstan bcos kyi don thams cad mngon sum du myong nas sam 'on te bla ma'i gdams ngag las 'chad | </seg></TEI>
